Class Fraction

java.lang.Object
Fraction
public class Fraction extends Object
Fraction class which allows for computations of rational numbers without having to worry about floating point rounding errors. Keeps infinite precision as long as the numerator and denominator fall within the 64-bit long limit.

      public Fraction(long numer, long denom)
      Create a Fraction with a specified numerator and denominator. Fraction will be simplified upon creation.

      denom - the denominator

    • Fraction

      public Fraction(long num)

      Parameters:

    • Fraction

      public Fraction(String input)
      Makes a fraction based off a string. Fraction may include parenthesis. Defaults to 1 when the string is empty. (Also defaults to -1 when the input string is just a negative sign)
      Parameters:
      input - the input string to parse
      Throws:
      NumberFormatException - when the numerator/denominator is not a number
      InputMismatchException - when there is more than 1 fraction bar
